svg.title: Power Widget — complete single-sheet schematic, bench revision A
svg.desc: All 82 physical components and 65 nets on one page. Continuous wires, junction dots and bridged crossings; no off-sheet connections. Green: inline circuit. Blue: isolated PC circuit. Pin groups list every connected pin number. NC pins are listed within the package. Derived from circuit.json; this is a documentation drawing, not the editable KiCad project.

g.text: BENCH REVISION A · COMPLETE SINGLE-SHEET SCHEMATIC
28 V design target / 9 A target / SELECTED USB PARTS: 5 A MAX

g.title: J1: USB4115-03-C / USB path 5A MAX. 24 contacts, 48 V / 5 A manufacturer rating. This bench population is limited to 5 A via USB; a 9 A assembly remains a procurement gate.
P1: Captive harness solder termination. Board-side termination, not a USB mating footprint. Candidate USB4155-03-C plug is 48 V / 5 A only; custom harness drawing/qualification remains open.
R1: WSK25125L000DEA, four-terminal 5 mΩ / 1 W shunt. 1/2 force; 3/4 Kelvin.
J2: 691137710002 / force terminal. Wurth 16 A UL / 24 A VDE, 5.00 mm pitch, 1.30 mm drills. Force path capacity still requires PCB thermal testing.
J3: 691137710002 / force terminal. Wurth 16 A UL / 24 A VDE, 5.00 mm pitch, 1.30 mm drills. Force path capacity still requires PCB thermal testing.
J4: Kelvin probe pads; NOT force pins. Use small pads near the defined B-plane. No main current through this header.
U1: INA228AIDGSR. Address 0x40. Wide ADC range. Footprint candidate still requires package drawing review.
J6: INLINE I2C debug. Only a floating or isolated instrument here; never jumper to J5.
U2: ISO1641BD. Side 1 PC, side 2 inline. SCL is unidirectional; INA228 does not require clock stretching.
J5: PC I2C / external MCU. 3V3 is switched reference/output. Hold onboard MCU in reset and fit JP4 for another open-drain master; no external pull-ups to an always-on rail.
JP3: INLINE self-current link. Fit shunt normally; insert a floating ammeter to characterize sensor-side self-consumption. Not a main-current connection.
U4: TPS7A4333DGQR. 85 V fixed 3.3 V regulator. EN intentionally floating per internal pull-up; never tie EN to high VBUS. MID selected 15 V, with capacitors sized >=3x total OUT capacitance.
JP1: SENSOR SUPPLY: one shunt only. Normal 1-2; floating external 3.3 V 2-3. Do not install two shunts.
J7: Floating external 3.3V. For zero-VBUS/low-voltage bench testing; not connected to PC supply.
J1: USB4115-03-C / USB path 5A MAX. 24 contacts, 48 V / 5 A manufacturer rating. This bench population is limited to 5 A via USB; a 9 A assembly remains a procurement gate.
P1: Captive harness solder termination. Board-side termination, not a USB mating footprint. Candidate USB4155-03-C plug is 48 V / 5 A only; custom harness drawing/qualification remains open.
J8: USB4105-GF-A-120 / reporting. Long board edge. USB 2.0 receptacle may omit unused SS/SBU contacts after exact footprint selection.
U6: USBLC6-2SC6. Route lines through paired pads with short ground return. PC port only.
U3: STM32F072CBT6 / 128K flash. Pinout checked against ST DS9826 Rev 6 figure 8. 16 KB RAM. HSI48/CRS USB clock.
J9: Cortex SWD 2x5 1.27mm. Key pin 7 absent. No SWO on Cortex-M0. Debug probe must not power this board.
J10: UART 3.3V logic. TX/RX named from board viewpoint; 3V3 reference only. Not RS-232 voltage levels.
JP2: PC supply current link. Fit shunt normally. Remove to measure reporting-domain supply current; no external power injection.
U7: TPS22919DCKR. Switch U2 side 1 and its pull-ups off in USB suspend. Set PB6/PB7 high impedance first. QOD tied to output.
JP4: External-master enable; DNF. Fit only for external-master bench use with U3 held reset; remove for USB suspend testing.

g.text: Same J1 and P1 as above. No inline PD controller or substituted contract.
Dot = connected. Hop = no connection. Comma-separated pins are tied. NC = unconnected. J1 / P1 each appear in two sections.
Green = inline domain; blue = PC domain. GND_INLINE and GND_PC are separate. U2 is the signal isolation barrier.
82 components · 65 nets · 1 sheet · no off-sheet labels
JP1: fit ONE shunt, 1–2 normal / 2–3 external. JP2 and JP3 fitted. JP4 not fitted. Switches shown released.
Engineering draft; unbuilt and unqualified. Complete values / pin data: circuit.json. Editable circuit: KiCad project.
